name: NewObjectTypeDialog
intent: Four-step authoring wizard for an ontology object type: metadata, datasources, properties, review.
when: Adding an object type to a shared ontology
Any four-stage authoring flow over a typed record
whenNot: Editing an existing object type -> open its detail page

chooseOver.component: A hand-built Stepper in a Dialog
chooseOver.because: It carries the whole four-step contract — never-disabled Next, per-step validation, an assembled draft — and is entirely prop-driven, so a host with its own glyphs, datasources and base types reuses it unchanged.

groups.note: Group facets offered on the Metadata step.

icons.note: NewObjectTypeDraft.iconIndex indexes into THIS array, so a caller maps the index back to its own icon name.

baseTypes.note: Property base types on the Properties step; defaults to the eight common ones.

showLayer.note: Show the L1–L4 layer selector. Off for ontologies with no layer concept.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Drafts carry no id; the host mints one on accept.

states.metadata: Display name, API name, status, visibility and optional layer.
states.datasource: Attach one or more datasources; duplicate keys raise a heads-up rather than a block.
states.properties: At least one property required before Review.
states.review: The assembled draft, with any duplicate-key warning restated.

minimalExample:
import {NewObjectTypeDialog} from "@corensystem/coren-ui/new-object-type-dialog";

<NewObjectTypeDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} onCreate={(draft) => addObjectType(draft)} />
evaluationCriteria: iconIndex maps back to the caller's own icon array.

lineage.authoredBy: Promoted in group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
notes: Its wizard chrome is the one wc3-action-type-wizard.tsx and wc3-product-install-dialog.tsx were copied from — see WizardDialog, which now owns it.
Already an exported component with a typed props interface and no fixture coupling — this manifest is the only thing that was missing.

usage: Use NewObjectTypeDialog when you need to display content that temporarily overlays the main interface. This component is useful for focused interactions, confirmations, or supplementary information.
NewObjectTypeDialog should be used sparingly as overlays interrupt the user's workflow. Reserve this component for important interactions that require user attention or action before continuing.

props.name: groups
props.description: Group facets offered on the Metadata step.

props.name: datasources
props.description: Datasources offered on the Datasource step.
